At 16¢ that's about $75 a month in power for the 40T at $799. Most people buy it for the shot at a full block — it draws every ten minutes, for years, and you keep the machine.

Is this your first miner?

At 39¢ the 40T runs about $183 a month in power — that's real money, so worth knowing up front. At home rates the sats usually come to less than the electricity; that's not why people buy it. It's the block shot and owning a working piece of the network.

Want the same math on a smaller, cheaper-to-run unit?
